# awscc_appsync_api_cache (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::AppSync::ApiCache



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_caching_behavior` (String) Caching behavior, such as FULL_REQUEST_CACHING, PER_RESOLVER_CACHING, or OPERATION_LEVEL_CACHING
- `api_id` (String) Unique AWS AppSync GraphQL API identifier.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds for cache entries. Valid values are 1-3600.
- `type` (String) The cache instance type, such as SMALL, LARGE and LARGE_4X

### Optional

- `at_rest_encryption_enabled` (Boolean) At-rest encryption flag for cache. You cannot update this setting after creation.
- `health_metrics_config` (String) Controls how cache health metrics will be emitted to CloudWatch. Cache health metrics include NetworkBandwidthOutAllowanceExceeded and EngineCPUUtilization
- `transit_encryption_enabled` (Boolean) Transit encryption flag when connecting to cache. You cannot update this setting after creation.

### Read-Only

- `api_cache_id` (String) The CloudFormation primary identifier for an ApiCache. Mirrors ApiId once the resource exists; populated by the handler. Customers should reference the ApiCache by ApiId.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appsync_api_cache.example
  identity = {
    id = "id"
  }
}
```
